verdict.rationale: Dynadot is a domain registrar that ships AI features (AI Domain Search, an MCP server), so a buyer could fairly ask whether customer data is kept out of AI model training. The evidence pack has no AI-training opt-out, data-usage policy or training exclusion of any kind. WHOIS privacy and account security are adjacent privacy controls and earn no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
